description_en: Creates a core word by calling CreateCoreWord
name: CreateCoreWord

parameters.help_en: The name of the core word. The name cannot be an empty string and cannot exceed 120 characters
parameters.help_zh: 核⼼词名称，不能为空字符串，不超过120个字符
parameters.name: core_word_name

parameters.help_en: The business space key. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value from the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不传时访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

CoreWordCode.description_en: The core word code, which is generated by the system and is globally unique. This code is the unique identifier for accessing core word data
CoreWordCode.description_zh:
